title: Shoes Shop Website

requirements.text: Create a homepage with a full-width hero section featuring a compelling tagline and call-to-action button, followed by a featured products grid showcasing selected shoes.

quotes: Create a website for shoes shop

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section spans full width with a background image, headline, subheadline, and a prominent CTA button
Featured products section displays at least 4–6 product cards with image, name, and price
Page is responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop

requirements.text: Create a product listing page that displays all shoes organized by category (e.g., Men, Women, Kids, Sport) with filter options for size, color, and price range.

quotes: Create a website for shoes shop

acceptanceCriteria: Category tabs or sidebar allows filtering by shoe category
Filter panel supports size, color, and price range selections
Product grid updates to reflect active filters
Each product card shows thumbnail, name, category, and price

requirements.text: Create a product detail page showing multiple product images, product name, description, available sizes, color options, price, and an Add to Cart button.

quotes: Create a website for shoes shop

acceptanceCriteria: Product images are displayed in a gallery or carousel
Size selector allows user to pick a size before adding to cart
Color selector is shown if multiple colors are available
Add to Cart button is prominently displayed and functional

requirements.text: Implement a backend data store in Motoko for shoe products, including fields: id, name, description, category, price, available sizes, colors, and image URLs.

quotes: Create a website for shoes shop

acceptanceCriteria: Backend actor exposes query methods to list all products and get a product by ID
Backend actor exposes update methods to add and remove products
Data is persisted in stable variables
Sample seed data with at least 8 products across multiple categories is pre-loaded

requirements.text: Implement a shopping cart that allows users to add products, adjust quantities, remove items, and see a running total.

quotes: Create a website for shoes shop

acceptanceCriteria: Cart icon in the navigation header shows item count badge
Cart drawer or page lists all added items with image, name, size, quantity controls, and subtotal
Users can increment, decrement, or remove items from the cart
Order total is calculated and displayed correctly
Cart state persists across page navigation within the session

requirements.text: Create an About/Contact page with a brief brand story, contact form (name, email, message), and store information (address, phone, hours).

quotes: Create a website for shoes shop

acceptanceCriteria: About section contains brand story copy and imagery
Contact form has name, email, and message fields with basic validation
Store info section displays address, phone number, and business hours
Page is styled consistently with the rest of the site

requirements.text: Apply a bold, modern visual theme across the entire site using a warm neutral palette (off-white, charcoal, warm tan/caramel accents), strong sans-serif typography, generous whitespace, and clean card layouts that evoke a premium retail aesthetic.

quotes: Create a website for shoes shop

acceptanceCriteria: A consistent color palette using off-white, charcoal, and caramel/warm tan accents is applied site-wide
Typography uses a bold sans-serif for headings and a clean sans-serif for body text
Navigation bar is clean with logo, category links, and cart icon
Hover states, transitions, and interactive feedback are smooth and consistent throughout

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor file
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui
No external payment integrations or authentication required for this initial build

required: Wide lifestyle hero banner showing stylish sneakers and shoes arranged on a clean surface with warm neutral tones (hero-banner.dim_1440x600.png)
Brand logo mark — a minimalist shoe silhouette icon in charcoal on a transparent background (logo-icon.dim_128x128.png)
Sample men's athletic sneaker product photo on white background (product-mens-sneaker.dim_600x600.png)
Sample women's heeled boot product photo on white background (product-womens-boot.dim_600x600.png)
Sample kids' colorful sneaker product photo on white background (product-kids-sneaker.dim_600x600.png)
Sample unisex casual loafer product photo on white background (product-casual-loafer.dim_600x600.png)
